result.fundName: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 6.83% (21.68% vs 14.86%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Small Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.58 vs benchmark 1.01, Sortino 2.01.
Defensive profile: beta 0.68 with 26% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 11.86% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.35).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -19.35% vs benchmark -58.77%.
Rolling return range spans 17.69% to 25.14% (7.45 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
